minor.issue: Endpoint lowercases email before insert/update (line 86: email.strip().lower()) but POST /api/auth/login does case-sensitive lookup ({'email': credentials.email}). If admin is created or reset with a mixed-case email, the resulting account is stored lowercase and the user MUST login with lowercase. Recommendation: lowercase email on register/login too, or store original casing in reset-password.

FLAKY carry-over from iter5-8: test_login_lockout_triggers_through_public_url got 401 instead of 429 on the 6th attempt. Lockout key uses x-forwarded-for first hop, but K8s ingress sometimes rotates the visible IP between requests, so the same client appears as different identifiers and lockout doesn't trigger reliably.

issues: Google Maps InvalidKeyMapError (placeholder REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY) renders 'Oops! Something went wrong.' overlay inside the dashboard. Cosmetic — expected in preview, but consider a branded placeholder when key is missing.

action_items: (LOW consistency) Lowercase email in /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register to match the lowercasing already done in /api/admin/reset-password — prevents case-mismatch login 401 for newly created/reset admins.

(carry-over HIGH security) Make brute-force lockout K8s-ingress-aware in a robust way (e.g., trust full XFF chain or use a session cookie/device fingerprint) — current x-forwarded-for first-hop is still bypassable when ingress rotates source IP, and causes the test_login_lockout_triggers_through_public_url flake.
(LOW cosmetic) Replace Google Maps 'Oops/InvalidKeyMapError' overlay in AdminDashboard with a branded placeholder when REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is the placeholder.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js routes (lines 82-108) are clean: '/' always renders <Landing/> (no auth check), '/nubo-control' branches on user.role admin|manager → AdminDashboard else AdminLogin, '/admin' Navigate to '/nubo-control', '/dashboard' for admin/manager Navigate to '/nubo-control'. Matches the spec.

All required data-testids present (admin-login-page, admin-login-form, admin-login-email, admin-login-password, admin-login-submit).

Landing.js: nav-track-btn (line 75) → /track, nav-quote-btn (line 83) → /presupuesto, hero-cta-btn (106) → /presupuesto, hero-track-btn (114) → /track, footer-cta-btn (174) → /presupuesto. NO nav-login-btn anywhere. Spec satisfied.
